title: 2026北京马拉松竞赛规程/报名须知（直通标准、伴跑条款与罚则）
claims: Entry requires runners to be at least 20 years old in the year of the race; runners aged 65 or above must complete a health self-assessment and submit a commitment form signed by themselves and family members.
A mass entrant must hold one marathon result or two half-marathon results within the 24 months before the entry deadline; virtual-race results are invalid.
The entry fee is CNY 200 per runner; once paid it is non-refundable and the place is personal and non-transferable.

Time-based direct entry follows the age-gender standards from the 2025 Beijing Marathon: men 2:40:00 at 20-34 down to 4:00:00 at 70+, women 3:10:00 at 20-34 down to 4:30:00 at 70+; a separate Guangzhou Marathon mutual-entry draw awards 200 places.

Only guide runners registered and reported to the organiser may accompany a visually impaired runner; the guide must be an accepted entrant in the same event, and unreported accompaniment carries self-responsibility.
The race does not include a racing wheelchair division; non-racing wheelchair runners must assemble at the rear under referee and volunteer guidance.

For violations such as false information, bib or chip transfer, or using another race's bib, the organiser may disqualify the result, impose a one-to-five-year ban or a lifetime ban, and refer serious cases to the Chinese Athletics Association.

Clothing rules require a visible bib; masks or helmets that obscure identity, sharp hard or detachable accessories, trailing entanglement-prone clothing, over-size props and revealing or offensive costumes are prohibited; strollers are barred from start, finish and course; littering off designated areas is prohibited.

Non-racing wheelchair and visually impaired runners who need support must download the application form from the official site, attach the disability certificate, and return it to oc@beijing-marathon.com by 22 September 18:00.

The registration window for mass runners was 17 September 10:00 to 22 September 18:00; ballot results and payment followed in late September to early October, with no waitlist for unpaid places unless a re-entry round is announced.
